title: TOOL-LIFE-X labelled CLOSED - INDEPENDENTLY ACCEPTED while the only independent exact-SHA audit is CONDITIONAL / STOP
affected_invariant: Roadmap section 2.3 independent acceptance; ARCH-FREEZE entry (TOOL-LIFE-X = CLOSED)
impact: The status cell and ledger keep the INDEPENDENTLY ACCEPTED label although AUD-TOOLLIFE returned CONDITIONAL / chain gate STOP at the acceptance baseline (C-1 four red tests, C-2 F3 parent-cancel test), no external review artefact exists (F-03), and OD-ROUTE-DS3 states the stage is neither accepted nor waived and that treatment of the label is not decided. No re-audit result exists at BASELINE. The roadmap annotation (DR-3) discloses this but leaves the headline label unchanged. Parent may raise to HIGH if A2/Campaign B confirms the red tests at the pinned SHA (not re-executed here).
recommendation: Owner decides the label (e.g. CLOSED - SCOPED, ACCEPTANCE CONDITIONAL) or completes the re-audit authorised by OD-ROUTE-DS3 at a post-correction SHA; until then downstream consumers must not cite TOOL-LIFE-X as independently accepted.
